product_family: Comprehensive social media management platform (Hootsuite) with AI-powered insights and content generation (Wisdom AI), customer care and messaging (Sparkcentral), and employee advocacy (Parliament). Serves 25M+ users across 200+ countries.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II audit performed annually by independent third party auditor. Security controls are independently tested and audited by an international accounting firm on an annual basis.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: Hootsuite holds SOC 3 certification as part of comprehensive information security policies grounded in Trust Service Criteria.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Comprehensive set of information security policies based on ISO/IEC 27001/27002 standards. Sparkcentral (Hootsuite product) is ISO 27001 certified and will make every effort to maintain this certification indefinitely.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27002
certifications.proof_quote: Information security policies based on ISO/IEC 27001/27002 information security standards.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27017 - Security guidelines for cloud services - part of Hootsuite's comprehensive security framework.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27018 - Personal data protection in cloud services - part of Hootsuite's information security standards.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701 - Privacy controls for protecting personal information - part of Hootsuite's certified frameworks.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Hootsuite complies with applicable international privacy laws such as the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Hootsuite has appointed a data protection officer and dedicated privacy team with executive-level Privacy Council.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Hootsuite is BAA-compliant and HIPAA-friendly, having adopted various administrative, physical and technical safeguards relevant to its environment for consistency with HIPAA standards.

certifications.name: FedRAMP Tailored Li-SaaS
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP authorization demonstrates compliance with rigorous standards governed by an external body for U.S. Federal agencies.

certifications.name: Cyber Essentials
certifications.proof_quote: Hootsuite has achieved compliance with the Cyber Essentials program (UK Government cybersecurity requirements for suppliers handling sensitive information).

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification found on Hootsuite's official domain. Mentioned in third-party aggregators but not on hootsuite.com or trustcenter.hootsuite.com.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Hootsuite does not store, transmit, or process credit card information directly. Payment processing outsourced to third-party PCI DSS compliant vendors. Hootsuite stores only anonymous tokens identifying processed transactions.

privacy.ai_training_note: Hootsuite uses customer content and outputs to develop and improve features of AI-Powered Services (including machine-learning technologies for Wisdom AI). However, customer data is NOT used to train third-party AI Service Providers and is NOT shared with other customers. No opt-out mechanism is documented; Wisdom AI can be disabled/restricted at the organization level.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region: Canada (primary), European Union, United States, Asia-Pacific (Singapore, Japan, India). Uses AWS and Hetzner for cloud infrastructure.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or above; latest secure cipher suites and protocols supported

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: All Customer Information encrypted at rest

security.name: Cryptographic Monitoring
security.value: Hootsuite actively monitors cryptographic developments and makes commercially reasonable efforts to upgrade Services in response to new cryptographic weaknesses.

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Least privilege principles, regular access reviews, password complexity requirements, multi-factor authentication for employee and contractor access

security.name: Logging & Intrusion Detection
security.value: Centralized logging and automated monitoring for suspicious activity; annual third-party penetration testing

security.name: Data Redundancy
security.value: Redundant data storage across multiple data center locations for disaster recovery and business continuity

security.name: Third-Party Audits
security.value: Annual SOC 2 Type II audits by independent third-party auditors; annual third-party security penetration testing

products.name: Hootsuite Platform (Core)
products.data_scope: Social media content, user credentials, analytics, customer interactions
products.notes: Primary product for scheduling, publishing, monitoring, and analyzing social media. Includes 100+ integrations with business tools.

products.name: Wisdom AI
products.data_scope: Social media content, trends, customer conversations
products.notes: AI agent for trend discovery, sentiment analysis, content recommendations, and AI-assisted post drafting. Uses customer data for service improvement but not for third-party training.

products.name: Sparkcentral
products.notes: Acquired product for unified customer care messaging. ISO 27001 certified separately.

products.name: Parliament
products.data_scope: Pre-approved brand content, employee sharing activity
products.notes: Platform for employee social advocacy and amplification of company content.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS with tiered subscriptions: Standard, Professional, Advanced, Enterprise. Free trial available.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region with primary processing in Canada; data can be processed in EU, US, and APAC. Canadian entity provides GDPR advantage (adequate protection status).

flags: AI training on customer content for service improvement (Wisdom AI) is disclosed and required by ToS, but no opt-out mechanism is documented. Organizations can disable Wisdom features entirely.

Sparkcentral is ISO 27001 certified; primary Hootsuite platform's direct ISO 27001 certification status is not explicitly stated (policies based on ISO standards but certification may be product-specific).
HIPAA BAA available but not publicly posted online - this is standard industry practice for negotiated agreements; must be requested from sales/legal.
Data residency: AWS and Hetzner used; GDPR data processed in EU facilities but may have US nexus depending on cloud provider regional configuration.
